display_long_description:
Monkey Jumpers V3 is the next evolution of the Monkey Jumpers series — a multiplayer VR experience inspired by fast-paced climbing and tag-style gameplay. Race across walls, leap between platforms, and swing your way through creative environments while competing with friends or hanging out casually.

Maps to Explore:

🪐 Zero Gravity – Defy physics and leap higher than ever.

🔥 Rising Lava – Stay off the ground or get burned as lava rises around you.

🧗 Parkour – Test your skill with jumps, climbs, and obstacles.

🛍️ Mall – Hang out, find cosmetics, and customize your monkey’s look.

🔪Murder Mystery - Survive the murderer! Help if you are the sheriff, and STAY ALIVE!

AND MUCH MORE!

Game Modes:

🦠 Infection – Tag others before you get tagged yourself.

🧭 Ranked - Make it to the top before anyone else!

🙈 Casual – Explore maps and practice movement with no pressure.

Core Features:

🎨 Color changing to make your monkey your own.

⚙️ Adjustable graphics and quality settings for smooth gameplay.

✍️ Name changing to personalize your profile.

🔑 Join private or public rooms to play how you want.

🏆 Leaderboard system with secure reporting to keep games fair.

Whether you’re competing to be the fastest climber, surviving the lava, or just chilling in the shop, Monkey Jumpers V3 gives you endless ways to play, customize, and connect.
